kd96363a5: It is never too late to start over. Change is possible thanks to Jesus Christ.
kfeea97be: We all make mistakes. We all have moments we are not proud of. But the gospel of Jesus Christ teaches us something wonderful: we can always start again.
k6e5eb5f8: Repentance is not a punishment — it is a gift. It is the opportunity God gives us to leave behind what weighs us down and move forward with hope and peace.
k893edc88: To repent means to change — to change your heart, your direction, your attitude. It is not just about feeling guilty, but about deciding to improve and turning to Jesus Christ for His help.
ka98c7467: <t1>Recognize:</t1> Admit before God and before yourself that you have made a mistake
k4b9ca69c: <t1>Feel:</t1> Experience a sincere desire to change, not just fear of punishment
kb794119b: <t1>Confess:</t1> Speak with God in prayer and, when necessary, with the people affected
kd2e80bf0: <t1>Forsake:</t1> Stop doing what was wrong and work hard not to repeat it
k32a3006e: <t1>Repair:</t1> Do what you can to make up for the harm caused
k56186b21: Repentance is possible thanks to the Atonement of Jesus Christ. He has already paid the price for our mistakes. When we repent sincerely, He forgives us completely — He holds no grudge, keeps no record, and does not remind us of what is already behind us.
kb63b1d7c: As the scripture says: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.
k39d650a9: It is not weakness, it is courage
k3ec2c034: Repenting takes humility and courage. It is not a sign of weakness — it is one of the bravest things you can do. Every day is a new opportunity to come closer to the person God knows you can become.
kb1e624bb: Do you want to start over?
k04799535: It doesn't matter what your past is. There is hope for you. Talk to us and discover the power of forgiveness.
kf217b51f: The first step on the path of discipleship of Jesus Christ.
k99ad2a66: Baptism is the first ordinance of the gospel of Jesus Christ. It is a sacred covenant, or agreement, between you and God: you promise to follow Jesus Christ, and He promises to forgive your sins and guide you through the Holy Ghost.
kea4426ef: Jesus Christ Himself was baptized by John the Baptist in the Jordan River, setting the example for us to follow.
k08afb195: <t1>It is a commandment of God:</t1> Jesus Christ taught that baptism is necessary to enter the kingdom of God
kc17b7365: <t1>It symbolizes a new beginning:</t1> Being immersed in water represents leaving the old life behind and being born again
k42a4cffc: <t1>It is a covenant with God:</t1> By being baptized, you enter into a special relationship with your Heavenly Father
k61d7559f: <t1>It opens the door to the Holy Ghost:</t1> After baptism, you receive the gift of the Holy Ghost as a constant companion
k96b8cea3: Following the example of Jesus Christ, baptism is performed by complete immersion in water, by someone who holds the authority of God (the priesthood). This symbolizes the death, burial and resurrection of Jesus Christ, and your own spiritual rebirth.
k99699c08: Anyone who is at least 8 years old, who believes in Jesus Christ and who wishes to follow Him can be baptized. There is no requirement of perfection — baptism is precisely for those who want to start over.
kfdc23ad9: Baptism is not the end of the road, but the beginning. After baptism, you receive the gift of the Holy Ghost by the laying on of hands. The Holy Ghost will guide you, comfort you and help you make good decisions throughout your life.
k4d6da7f1: Want to know more about baptism?
kf91950d7: Our missionaries can answer all your questions and help you prepare if you decide to take this step.
ke8257e11: The family is central to God's plan. Family ties can be eternal.
k60ec7514: We believe the family is not a human invention — it is a divine institution, created by God. The family is where we learn to love, to forgive, to serve and to grow. It is the foundation of society and the most important unit in eternity.
k553d04bb: In a world where families face many challenges, the gospel of Jesus Christ offers principles that can strengthen and unite every family.
kde715a10: One of the most beautiful teachings of the restored gospel is that families can be together forever — not just “until death do us part,” but for all eternity.
kea23f10f: Through sacred ordinances performed in temples, husbands and wives can be sealed to each other, and parents to their children, creating bonds that go beyond death.
k696ad427: <t1>Family prayer:</t1> Praying together as a family invites God's guidance into the home
k67722e83: <t1>Scripture study:</t1> Reading the scriptures together strengthens faith and unites the family
k25fcddd1: <t1>Family home evening:</t1> Setting aside one evening a week to be together, learn and have fun
k122c79a1: <t1>Service:</t1> Serving others together creates deep bonds and teaches values
k9e688898: <t1>Forgiveness:</t1> Practicing forgiveness at home creates an atmosphere of peace and love
k547e420e: Your home can be a place of peace, love and spiritual safety. It doesn't matter how big your family is or what your current situation is — God can bless your home when you invite Him to be part of it.
k4f353a1b: The principles of the gospel of Jesus Christ — love, patience, forgiveness, service — are the recipe for a happy family. Not because it is easy, but because with God's help, it is possible.
k0ea27479: We want to help you discover how the gospel can bless your family. Talk to us.
k64769ab0: The center of our faith. The Savior of the world. Your most faithful friend.
kc93d01d0: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and the Savior of humankind. He lived a perfect life, taught the gospel of love, suffered for our sins, died on the cross and rose again on the third day. His sacrifice makes it possible for all of us to be forgiven, healed and reunited with God.
kd041bf8f: For us, Jesus Christ is not just a historical figure — He is alive today and knows you personally. He feels what you feel, understands your struggles and wants to help you.
ka7b741d9: <t1>Love:</t1> Love God and love your neighbor as yourself — these are the two great commandments
k6ca4e3eb: <t1>Forgiveness:</t1> He taught us to forgive those who offend us, freeing us from resentment
k364fd386: <t1>Service:</t1> “Whoever wants to be great among you must be your servant”
kf4ecd517: <t1>Faith:</t1> Trusting in God even when we don't understand everything
k80483b3c: <t1>Hope:</t1> No matter how dark the night, there is always a dawn
k8d6a1d4b: The most important event in history took place in the Garden of Gethsemane and on the cross at Calvary. Jesus Christ willingly took upon Himself the sins, pains and sicknesses of all humankind.
kbf0ab94c: This means that no matter what you have done or what has happened to you — there is hope. Through Christ, you can start over. You can be healed. You can find peace.
k29d46f1d: We believe Jesus Christ rose from the dead and lives today. He guides His Church through prophets and apostles, and He is eager to have a personal relationship with you through prayer.
k856b5719: You can talk to Him right now. You don't need fancy words or a special place — just a sincere heart.
kc37767f1: If you want to learn more about Jesus Christ and how He can change your life, we are here for you.
kc897784d: Another testament of Jesus Christ. An ancient book for today's world.
k509741f9: What is the Book of Mormon?
kb4f3bcb8: The Book of Mormon is a volume of sacred scripture comparable to the Bible. It contains the record of the prophets who lived on the American continent between about 600 B.C. and A.D. 421. Its central message is the same as that of the Bible: Jesus Christ is the Savior of the world.
keee5eff2: The name “Book of Mormon” comes from Mormon, a prophet who compiled and abridged the historical and spiritual records of his people. His son Moroni added the final pages and, centuries later, as a resurrected being, revealed the location of the plates engraved in gold to Joseph Smith in 1823.
kb55abbc1: How did it come to us?
k79b3224c: In 1823, the angel Moroni appeared to Joseph Smith and revealed the existence of buried gold plates
kafa30ed1: In 1827, Joseph Smith received the plates and translated them by the gift and power of God
